title.narrative: Increased capacity of constituents to drive effective application of international labour standards

description.narrative: The following are the major global deliverables and activities of the ILO in this policy area: (1) Facilitation of the work of the supervisory bodies and provision of support to follow-up on their recommendations at country level. (2) Facilitation of discussions of the supervisory bodies on their working methods, with a view to supporting their continuous improvement. (3) Progressive modernization of regular reporting modalities to facilitate Member States’ engagement as well as peer learning by rendering information on compliant national laws, regulations and policies publicly accessible. (4) Annual reports on on SDG indicator 8.8.2 on labour rights as per the methodology approved by the 20th International Conference of Labour Statisticians (ICLS) in 2018 and endorsed by the Governing Body, ensuring a better understanding of the underlying methodology and coding, both for constituents and ILO staff. (5) Capacity development of the tripartite constituents, members of the judiciary, labour dispute settlement authorities and legal professionals in collaboration with the Turin Centre.
